'''Vaal''' was a warm, grassy [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The planet was dominated by large savannas and was home to several ferocious predators.

Around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the remote [[Imperial Relay Outpost V-798]], commanded by [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Reybn]], was based on the planet. V-798 was notable for being the closest [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] outpost to the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]]. Vaal's [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] intersected with [[Vaal asteroid field|several]] treacherous [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] fields.<ref name="TSH" />

When his [[Darth Vader's TIE Advanced/Legends|modified]] [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]] was crippled at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was forced to crash-land on the planet. Vader made his way to V-798, but his journey was interrupted by an attack from a pack of vicious [[Hyenax]]. He [[Death/Legends|killed]] several of them, including their leader, earning their respect and becoming leader of the pack in the process. Later, Lord Vader saved the pack from another [[Unidentified Vaal creature|creature]]. He eventually reached a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] that took him to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], silently leaving the three [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="TSH" />
